items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: What are you going to do about Murray down there in Jacksonville, Florida?

ctx.x: What are you going to do about Murray down there in Jacksonville, Florida? All those fellas who read. You see, Dr. Locke wrote a book like that too. Oh yeah, I've read that. Yeah, and I could kick him all in the pants around some place for writing that kind of thing about there were no Negro musicians, no Negro bands of consequences. He didn't know. No. So he ought to devote himself to his time to the subject he teaches in Howard and leave this part up to somebody who knows. He was a little bit of a piece of…
